publication.author: Jeremy Rodgers
publication.relationship: Main paper and substantial technical supplement are one connected publication.

editorialDecisions: The main paper’s AI-assistance declaration is deliberately omitted from website articles, introductions, descriptions and metadata at the site owner’s request. It is the only deliberate source-content omission recorded here. Original downloadable PDFs remain unchanged, including declarations; no claim of solely human authorship is added.

Editable LaTeX sources and cited reproducibility archives were not supplied for this update. Mathematics was reconstructed from the supplied PDFs and rendered semantically through the existing math stack. This is a web-native adaptation, not a claim of byte-for-byte transcription.

Scientific experiments and finite computational checks described in the publication remain source-reported. Website preparation and rendering checks do not constitute rerunning unavailable experiments.
The unpublished recollective-interpretation draft remains a cited interlocutor, not another supplied or published programme item.
Main and supplement section/result numbering remains available alongside public-facing headings. Full notes in individual coverage records retain the scope of content checks.

validation.verificationScope: Independent structural audit of source-PDF subsection/result numbering against current Markdown coverage records and anchors; exact SHA256 comparison of original and downloadable PDFs. This audit does not prove philosophical claims or establish semantic equivalence of arbitrary machine implementations.
